items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I never worked for Lionel Hampton, and when I see him work I never did want to work with him

ctx.x: own towels and things. There was no running water, no showers or anything. But he sweated so much. He sweated very easily.

He worked hard. He really worked hard. He deserves every little... What little acclaim he got, he deserved every bit of it. A hard worker. He really worked hard. When he says he worked hard, you can believe him. He did. I mean, I worked with other leaders, too, but I never worked with no leader worked as hard as him. And I never worked for Lionel Hampton, and when I see him work I never did want to work with him, because he works hard and wants everybody else to work hard. I never wanted to work with one of them…
What about some other trumpeters that you remember, going all the way back to, say, Johnny Dunn?
